description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order to repeal the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1960/66 of 01.04.2016 published under the Exchange Central Act (Chapter 423 of the CLE)
categorisation: This gazette notice contains a legal/regulatory action - the repeal of a previous government gazette notification under the Exchange Control Act. It involves the Minister of Finance exercising statutory powers to modify the legal framework, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
